About Me

I am a Technical Game Designer and Systems Engineer who loves bridging the gap between creative vision and complex codebase architecture. I focus on developing clean, extensible mechanics that give players memorable emergent experiences.

Whether designing a procedural level generation algorithm or fine-tuning the frame data of a combat system, I build with performance, optimization, and game feel in mind.
